'''2018 European MPC Results Chris Menzel LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2018 European Match Play Championship]] (Results).

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
